name: characterize-flowcell-aquatic-site
description: Use before selecting or interpreting a FlowCell wet/field site; characterize the coupled hydraulic, sediment, ecological, ice, invasive-species, navigation, and recovery environment.
preconditions: candidate site or site class is named
the intended prototype/configuration and deployment season are identifiable
postconditions: resource and environmental envelope is bounded or unknowns are explicit
minimum additional measurement plan is stated
no site suitability is inferred solely from tide range or a single velocity reading
input-shape: FlowCell scientific/configuration evidence appropriate to the named procedure
output-shape: Typed FlowCell scientific evidence packet described by the postconditions
